route_selection: Five promising one-weekly outbacks including restored SVX-AER with primary route-specific scale, and two existing-RW-overlap controls; not a global optimum
technical_status: требует эксплуатационной проверки; nominal100 is not a confirmed payload
net_fuel_adjustment_definition: Net additional economic benefit after any newly accrued excise, refunds, pass-throughs and amounts already in supplier price. NOT gross deduction, not measured RW benefit, not paid route subsidy. 3024=2800*(2.08-1) conditional arithmetic illustration only; other points span the break-even gap, not a credible forecast interval.
paid_pax_interpretation: One-way journeys per departure; roundtrip has two legs. Equal-direction tests are assumptions; each direction separately exported. Required OD inferred backwards from uncalibrated capture, never observed demand.
transfer_upper_bound: Maximum-profit bipartite residual-seat flow, locals fixed, transfer OD unlimited, zero transfer migration. An optimistic upper bound with unchanged dated connection products, fares and flight costs; not whole-network optimum.
limits: No observed winter OD or net settlement yield added
UFA tariffs are public local references, not signed all-airport RW contracts
Fuel burn and all hourly costs remain analyst assumptions
Cost reductions, full load and higher fare at fixed sales are thresholds, not verified business plans
No pilot is justified by smaller loss; full economics, technical clearance and evidence of payable demand needed
segment_scale_warning: Actual historical flown route-pair passenger movements, not final OD. Annual/(2*52) assumes both directions and symmetry. Endpoint fractions and December/annual ratios are unknown; grid is a decision-boundary test, not an empirical confidence interval.
net_yield_audit_definition: Assumed carrier realised revenue per one-way journey after recoverable VAT and sales deductions, BEFORE the passenger/airport expenses itemised here. Future settlement data already net of those airport charges must not incur them again. Actual definition not established from sold tickets.
